gateway_routes.name: frontend
gateway_routes.purpose: The console itself: static files only

gateway_routes.name: ingest
gateway_routes.purpose: Telemetry and alarms from turbine devices, each with its own token

gateway_routes.name: keycloak-login
gateway_routes.purpose: Sign-in form posts, limited per address (SRS 7.5)

gateway_routes.name: sample
gateway_routes.purpose: The Phase 1 sample service, for the gateway checks

gateway_routes.name: web-bff-public
gateway_routes.purpose: What a sign-in page reads before anyone signs in: branding and the API contract

gateway_routes.name: web-bff
gateway_routes.purpose: The browser's API: only with a valid Keycloak token for this console
gateway_routes.sign_in: Keycloak bearer token, checked for issuer, audience and tenant

mcp_servers.boundary: Document permissions, checked by the service before any text is returned

tools.description: Read one passage by its citation, as it was indexed.
tools.name: documentation.read_passage
tools.title: Read a passage

tools.description: Search the approved manuals, service bulletins and procedures the caller may read, best match first. Each passage has a citation, its document and revision, and whether a later revision replaces it.
tools.name: documentation.search_documents
tools.title: Search documents

mcp_servers.boundary: Synthetic documents and evaluation fixtures, needing knowledge.read

tools.description: List a folder of the synthetic documents or the evaluation fixtures.
tools.name: filesystem.list_files
tools.title: List files

tools.description: Read one text file, of at most 256 KiB, from the synthetic documents or the evaluation fixtures.
tools.name: filesystem.read_file
tools.title: Read a file

tools.description: Connections to each service database by state, the longest running one's age and how many wait on locks. Never a query's text.
tools.name: postgres.connection_activity
tools.title: Connection activity

tools.description: Each service database's size, connections, commits, rollbacks, deadlocks, temporary bytes and cache hit ratio.
tools.name: postgres.database_overview
tools.title: Database overview

mcp_servers.boundary: Generic web research only. It holds no Tavily key

tools.description: Read up to five sources of a past search in full. Results are advisory only: no safety rule takes weather or anything else from them.
tools.name: tavily.extract_page
tools.title: Read found pages

tools.description: Read a past search as it was recorded, with its sources and extractions.
tools.name: tavily.get_research
tools.title: Read a past search

tools.description: Search the web on one topic, with a generic query. What was sent is returned, and each source is flagged stale, undated, low-confidence, conflicting or addressed to an AI. Results are advisory only: no safety rule takes weather or anything else from them.
tools.name: tavily.search_web
tools.title: Research the web

tools.description: A turbine's hourly forecast over a window of up to 7 days: wind at 10 m and at hub height, gusts, direction, temperature, precipitation, visibility and CAPE, each only when the provider gave it, with a summary and the forecast's provenance and age.
tools.name: weather.get_forecast
tools.title: Get a forecast

mcp_servers.boundary: The platform's own records, tenant-scoped; each service checks the user. Its one write is a draft work order
mcp_servers.calls: Asset, Telemetry, Alarm, Investigation, Production Impact, Policy, Inventory and Maintenance services

tools.description: Whether each named part fits a turbine and how many are available in its wind farm's store now: available, short, incompatible, retired or unknown. State a part's availability only from this. Checking holds nothing.
tools.name: windops.check_parts
tools.title: Check parts for a turbine

tools.description: The Policy Service's deterministic rules on a proposed action: pass, escalate or block, each rule with its version and reason. An agent cannot override it.
tools.name: windops.check_policy
tools.title: Check a proposal against policy

tools.description: A draft work order for a case: its tasks, crew, window, parts, the procedures it follows and the expected downtime. It is validated at once, and its problems come back. Only a draft: a person submits it, and another decides (FR-MNT-003).
tools.name: windops.create_draft_work_order
tools.title: Draft a work order

tools.description: A deterministic estimate of lost energy, availability and cost for an action on a case, each figure with a low to high range and its assumptions. Explain these figures; never change or invent one (FR-IMP-004).
tools.name: windops.estimate_impact
tools.title: Estimate the production impact

tools.description: Spare parts that fit a turbine's model, with how many are available in its wind farm's store now. Filter by component kind or words. Finding a part holds nothing: name it in a draft, and a person reserves it (FR-INVT-002).
tools.name: windops.find_parts
tools.title: Find parts for a turbine

tools.description: A case: its turbine, component group, status, severity, detections and current evidence snapshot.
tools.name: windops.get_case
tools.title: Get a case

tools.description: A frozen evidence snapshot and its items: what each record was, from which service, its window, data quality and content hash. Cite items by record_id.
tools.name: windops.get_evidence
tools.title: Get an evidence snapshot

tools.description: A turbine's latest reading of each metric, each with its unit and quality label. A reading marked suspect or missing is not evidence on its own.
tools.name: windops.get_latest_telemetry
tools.title: Get the latest telemetry

tools.description: A frozen telemetry snapshot's readings, summarized per metric: their count and quality, minimum, maximum, mean, first and last, the trend per hour, and the mean of each slice of the window. Take the snapshot_id from the telemetry item of the case's evidence. Cite a figure by its metric's record_id. A missing reading is counted, never averaged; suspect readings are not evidence on their own.
tools.name: windops.get_telemetry_summary
tools.title: Summarize frozen telemetry

tools.description: A turbine's wind farm, model, rated power, rotor, hub height and status.
tools.name: windops.get_turbine
tools.title: Get a turbine

tools.description: A turbine's alarms, newest first, each with its code, severity and state.
tools.name: windops.list_alarms
tools.title: List a turbine's alarms

tools.description: A turbine's cases, newest first: its fault history.
tools.name: windops.list_cases
tools.title: List a turbine's cases
